snippet.title: Reign of the Succubus - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Reign of the Succubus is a RPG that takes place on the Island of Eden, where it is rumored that all of one's desires shall be fulfilled. But is this true or merely a rumor? Find out in this RPG developed by TechnoBrake and published by Kagura Games!

On Steam:
http://bit.ly/2UV5S31

Kagura Games on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2NDC6sD

Developer: TechnoBrake
Publisher: Kagura Games
